policy: This is an inventory of the original sourceCommit, not the current legacy test count. Pure UI cases explicitly marked replaced-by-midscene are removed. Other mappings need assertion-level review before replacement; exact technical contracts remain deterministic. Local evidence is not remote CI evidence.
replacementPolicy: Pure UI originals marked replaced-by-midscene are removed. Reviewed mixed tests retain their technical contracts; reviewed technical-only originals are explicitly retained-technical. Unreviewed mappings still require assertion-level review. Candidate mappings alone are not complete coverage evidence.
